reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商同为攸缘游戏）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 35），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源：六条结果全部是本作商店页及其简体中文、保加利亚语版本、意大利语站点的社区中心页与更新说明页（版本号 0.4.111 的开发者补丁公告），以及一条指向本作试玩版（另一个 App ID 4813890）的商店页，均不含第三方对 AI 披露的核实内容。检索范围仅限工具实际返回的内容，不能据此认定没有其他公开报道。披露原文是两条没有标点分隔、直接连写的短句，本站按两条 bullet 分别登记商店页与游戏内背景图两项。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。

english.summary: A dungeon-loot RPG self-published by its developer on Sep 10, 2026. The store disclosure has two bullets only: this game's store page is generated by AI, and some background images inside the game were created with AI assistance; the other six areas are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher, both credited under this title's Chinese studio name) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 35); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 0 raw sources were read, because every result was the store page in English, Simplified Chinese or Bulgarian, the Italian community hub, an Italian-locale developer update post for build 0.4.111 and a store page for this title's demo under a different App ID, none of which carries third-party verification of the disclosure. That describes the search range and is not proof that no other coverage exists. The disclosure is two short bullets written back to back without punctuation, and they are logged separately here as the store page and the in-game background images. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
